remarks: Nearly new 2023 Dynamic manufactured home in Castleview Village.  Low Low Lot Fees! This bright 840 sq ft home offers 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, an open-concept living area and a modern kitchen with island seating - perfect for downsizers, first-time buyers or anyone wanting low-maintenance living. Step outside to your private deck and fenced yard with TWO storage sheds, so there is room for all your gear. Appliances included: fridge, stove, dishwasher, washer, dryer and garburator. Castleview Village is a well-kept co-operative (non-profit) park in Dunluce, where the lot rent of just $425/month includes water and garbage. Affordable way to own a nearly new home in northwest Edmonton, minutes to shopping, transit and Anthony Henday Drive. 2 high quality sheds, concrete parking pad for 2 cars.  Close to shopping, recreation and schools and public transit.  This is a great home and a great place to live.  Backing on to green space! (id:67522)
